# SelfDecode Health

> SelfDecode Health provides evidence-based health guides covering diseases, therapies, nutrition, and lifestyle strategies with scientific backing.

SelfDecode Health offers comprehensive articles on medical conditions, therapeutic approaches, and dietary interventions. The site emphasizes scientific evidence, genetic factors, and personalized health strategies across topics ranging from autoimmune diseases to mental health and nutrition.

## Key Topics

- Thyroid Health
- Gut Health & Leaky Gut Syndrome
- Autoimmune Diseases
- Intestinal Permeability
- Mental Health
- Cognitive Symptoms & Brain Fog
- Digestive Health
- Stress & Cortisol
- Genetic Factors
- Inflammation
- Complementary Therapies
- Nutrition & Diet
- Scientific Evidence
- Side Effects
- Hemoglobin & Red Blood Cells

## Thyroid & Endocrine Health

- [Hashimoto's Thyroiditis Genetic Factors](https://health.selfdecode.com/blog/genetic-causes-of-hashimotos-thyroiditis): Explores five key genetic factors in Hashimoto's thyroiditis development.
- [Diet, Foods & Strategies for Hypothyroidism Brain Fog](https://health.selfdecode.com/blog/hypothyroidism-brain-fog-diet): Natural diet strategies and lifestyle changes for hypothyroidism brain fog.
- [Hyperparathyroidism: Symptoms, Treatments, & Prevention](https://health.selfdecode.com/blog/hyperparathyroidism): Guide to hyperparathyroidism symptoms, PTH levels, and prevention strategies.

## Gut & Digestive Health

- [What is Leaky Gut Syndrome? + Causes & Symptoms](https://health.selfdecode.com/blog/leaky-gut-syndrome-signs-symptoms-treatments): Explores leaky gut syndrome causes, symptoms, and links to autoimmune diseases.
- [H. Pylori Infection Symptoms & Does it Cause Gastritis?](https://health.selfdecode.com/blog/h-pylori-symptoms-gastritis): Covers H. pylori infection symptoms, gastritis connection, and complications.
- [How Depression May Be Linked To Gut Microbes](https://health.selfdecode.com/blog/depression-genetics-gut-microbes-inflammation): Explores gut-brain axis connection between microbiome and depression.

## Mental Health & Cognitive Function

- [63 Factors that May Raise Stress & Cortisol Levels](https://health.selfdecode.com/blog/63-factors-raising-stress-cortisol-level-backed-science): Comprehensive guide to 63 stress factors and cortisol level management.
- [Can ADHD Cause Brain Fog?](https://health.selfdecode.com/blog/adhd-brain-fog): Examines ADHD's potential link to brain fog and cognitive symptoms.
- [3 Biological Causes of Vascular Migraines](https://health.selfdecode.com/blog/migraines-and-headaches-causes-and-solutions): Explains three biological causes of migraines and inflammation mechanisms.
- [What is Neurofeedback Therapy? + Potential Side Effects](https://health.selfdecode.com/blog/neurofeedback): Explains neurofeedback therapy mechanisms, types, and potential side effects.

## Medical Conditions & Treatments

- [Thalassemia: Causes, Symptoms, Diagnosis](https://health.selfdecode.com/blog/thalassemia): Covers thalassemia genetics, treatments, and complementary health approaches.
- [5 Benefits of Oxygen Therapy + Side Effects](https://health.selfdecode.com/blog/oxygen-therapy): Examines oxygen therapy benefits, risks, and medical applications.
- [The Controversy of Optimal Cholesterol Levels](https://health.selfdecode.com/blog/the-controversy-of-optimal-cholesterol-levels): Discusses optimal cholesterol levels and personalized health recommendations.

## Nutrition & Diet Guides
